findings.title: Background timeout also interrupts foreground continuation work
findings.description: Once `_read_turn` receives an idle timeout, it applies that timeout to every subsequent message wait—even after a task notification clears the ledger and the parent starts its continuation. Reproduced: notification → parent text → slow foreground work returns partial text as success, with no tasks stopped. Disable the background timer when foreground work resumes and test this transition.

findings.title: Completed tasks can still owe a continuation turn
findings.description: An empty active-task ledger does not establish that the response is complete. If a task notification arrives before the dispatch’s own result, this branch returns without consuming the parent’s pending continuation. Reproduced with the scripted client: only “Waiting” was returned; the subsequent “Wrote design” turn remained unread. Track pending continuations or authoritative session-idle state, and cover this ordering.

findings.title: Model switching bypasses the unusable-session guard
findings.description: After reconnect failure, `DispatchAction` calls `session.set_model()` before guarded `dispatch()`. Because `set_model()` lacks `_require_usable()`, the real disconnected client raises “Not connected” instead of preserving the recorded reconnect failure. Reproduced using a real `ClaudeSDKClient` with a failing connect. Guard model switching too; the current mock-based batch test conceals this behavior.
